about: What the plugin does, as a catalog adopt matches a repo's local files against (dev #835, design 6.4.2). The numbers are OURS: changing one is a reviewed change with its test. 'descriptions' is the one section a reader who must not see the scoring may read: it names each capability, its counterpart and the behaviour in prose, with no pattern and no weight.

content-editor.does: Reviews what a site's pages say: every fact traced to the person's content, no placeholders, voice, structure and consistency across pages.
behaviour: traces each fact on a page to the person's content or decisions
judges voice and tone against the brand notes
checks structure and consistency across pages

privacy-guard.counterpart: agent privacy-guard plus the check_site privacy family
privacy-guard.does: Decides what is safe to be public forever: location, other people, documents, image metadata, unapproved content, comments in the page source.
behaviour: treats anything published as public forever
looks for location details (home address, geotags)

route.does: Walks the built site: navigation, external links, base paths, retired pages and head metadata.
behaviour: walks every page of the built site
checks navigation and that every internal link resolves
checks that links work under both base paths
checks head metadata (title, description, social tags)

visual-qa.does: Looks at the rendered site at several widths and themes: overflow, spacing, legibility, image presentation and page weight.
behaviour: looks at screenshots of the rendered pages
at narrow and wide widths and in light and dark themes
judges spacing, alignment, contrast and legibility

brand-advisor.does: Proposes identity, messaging, visual direction, layout, typography and how images are presented, from the person's decisions.
behaviour: works on the site's identity and positioning
proposes visual direction: colour, typography, layout
advises how photography and images are presented
thinks about audience paths through the site

portfolio-advisor.does: Chooses which pieces of work to show and in what order, how each tells its story, and interviews the person for what a case study needs.
behaviour: selects and curates which pieces to show
shapes each piece as a story (brief, role, approach, outcome)
interviews the person for the facts
points out gaps in the set
advises on a printable portfolio PDF

presence-advisor.does: Advises on profile text aligned with the site, search visibility, social previews, a light content plan and analytics options.
behaviour: writes or reviews profile text and bios
advises on search visibility and keywords
suggests a light content plan and posting rhythm

publish.does: The publish routine: check state, dry run, ask for confirmation, deploy, read the live site back, record it in HANDOFF.
behaviour: does a dry run and shows the changes

setup.does: Sets up a non-developer's machine one step at a time: tools, GitHub sign-in, a browser, a copy of the site.
behaviour: installs or checks the tools one step at a time
gets a copy of the repo

add-work.does: Adds or updates a piece of work: front matter, images, draft status, required fields.
behaviour: adds a new piece or updates one
keeps it as a draft until ready

resume.does: Keeps the resume page and its PDF current.
behaviour: regenerates the PDF when the source changes

import-profile.does: Imports content from the person's own profile data export.
behaviour: reads an export file the person downloaded

ideas.does: Asks the brand, portfolio and presence advisors for ideas in parallel and combines what they return.
behaviour: combines them into one set of ideas

review.does: Runs the pre-publish review sequence: the checks, then the reviewers, then a verdict.
behaviour: runs the checks first, then the reviewers

capture.does: Captures a public post or page as a reference with a preview card.
behaviour: takes a link and captures its text and preview card
asks whether it joins the home feed or becomes a piece's cover

portfolio-list.does: Lists the portfolio: every piece, its status and its fields.
behaviour: lists the pieces of each portfolio

builder.does: Builds the site: strips comments, writes .nojekyll, writes CNAME only after cutover, supports drafts and a listing, expands page tokens, writes the output folder.
behaviour: strips HTML and CSS comments from the output
writes CNAME only when the site has cut over to its own domain
supports a drafts mode and a listing mode
writes the built site to a dist folder

content-loader.does: Loads page content: a small Markdown subset with front matter, video links that embed, drafts that never build, captured references as cards.
behaviour: turns a video link on its own line into an embed

checker.does: Checks a built site: no private paths, no comments, links resolve, no root-absolute links, privacy patterns, domain and cutover pairing, media metadata and size, unfinished markers.
behaviour: refuses private paths in the output
looks for phone numbers, street addresses and unlisted e-mail addresses
checks media for hidden metadata and size
looks for TODO, TBD and lorem

deploy.does: Deploys: builds, runs the gate, clones the public repo, replaces its contents with the built site, refuses forbidden paths, runs the gate again and pushes.
behaviour: wipes and replaces its contents with the built site
runs the gate before and after

doctor.does: Reports the state of the machine at session start: the tools present, the GitHub sign-in, a browser. Never installs anything and always exits 0.
behaviour: reports whether the tools are present

sync_main.does: Fast-forwards main at session start, never resetting anything, and does nothing when the checkout is dirty.
behaviour: does nothing when there are uncommitted changes

render.does: Takes full-page screenshots at several widths and themes in a browser and warns about horizontal overflow.
behaviour: at several widths and in light and dark themes

images.does: Prepares images: strips hidden metadata (EXIF, APP1 segments), makes responsive size copies, refuses very large files.
behaviour: strips APP1 / EXIF segments from JPEGs
refuses files over a size cap

capture-tool.does: Fetches a public page, reads its preview tags, writes a reference record and downloads the card image.

resume-pdf.does: Renders the resume page to a PDF at a paper size and records a hash of the source.
behaviour: prints the resume page to PDF
records a hash of the source

playwright-pin.does: A package.json whose only job is to pin Playwright for the browser tools.
